Janmashtami Celebrated Across India with Religious Observances

Janmashtami, the festival celebrating the birth of Lord Krishna, was observed across India. In Nathdwara, Rajasthan, the Shrinathji Temple marked the occasion with a 21-gun salute. Devotees engaged in religious practices, with some discussions focusing on the spiritual significance of Krishna worship, exploring themes of the idol versus the inner self.
